title: Make validateApp reject apps without an owner (libs/shared-contracts)
Pass owner from package.json team in core-shell, billing and reports
Build all apps locally, PR, CI, merge, confirm CD

summary: PLAT-103 shipped in PR #1 (merged 97ca6fc, CI and CD green). validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws 'app.owner is required' when owner is missing, non-string, or blank. core-shell (platform), sub-route-billing (payments) and sub-route-reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team. Assumptions: owner is hardcoded per app to match package.json rather than injected at build time; the contract is inlined in-repo, so no library version bump; the validation is in validateApp only, not in build.js. Local builds of all three apps passed before and after the change.
